title: Website Design Statistics 2026
subtitle: Fonts, headline sizes, dark mode and buttons on 196 SaaS and AI homepages
description:
Headline size, fonts, body text, dark mode, gradients and buttons, measured on the homepages of 196 SaaS and AI companies in November 2026.

Full write-up with charts: https://www.browsermoon.com/blog/website-design-statistics

Key findings: median headline 64px and 6 words; 84% of headlines use a brand's own or less common font (Inter 9%, Geist 5%); body text about 18px; 36% of homepages are dark; 53% use a gradient in the first screen; median main button 46px tall, blue in 29% of cases.

Method: homepages loaded in a desktop browser at 1440x900; 22 of 218 excluded for bot checks or failed loads. Columns are described on GitHub: https://github.com/sparow-svg/website-design-statistics
